# m-ko.de

> Markus Kosmal helps small and medium-sized businesses bring in AI so that it makes everyday work easier, with clear limits for what the AI may do. Based in Germany. Languages of the site: German, English, Portuguese.

## Offers

- [Review of AI components for agents and their operators](https://m-ko.de/agents/): a human reviews the skills, connectors and configuration of an AI agent against clear limits and puts a name and a date on the result. Machine-readable summary: https://m-ko.de/agents/offer.json . Guide price by size (S from 390 EUR, M from 890, L from 2,200, XL from 4,500); launch offer: half price for the first reviews. Size rules and calculator: https://m-ko.de/agents/#size . A browser-only folder scanner (no upload) produces the size block and a SHA-256 digest of the component: https://m-ko.de/agents/#scan
- [AI check and AI pentest](https://m-ko.de/security/): the AI check takes stock of how AI is used and sorts every ability into three levels (may do alone, needs a person's approval, stays off limits), from 490 EUR. The AI pentest includes the AI check and the production check, plus a real attack: a search for vulnerabilities in the system and attempts to exploit the AI, from 3,900 EUR. Pentests only with written permission and within an agreed scope.
- [Production check for AI-built apps](https://m-ko.de/check/): a human reviews an AI-built app before real users arrive. Includes the AI check. Fixed prices by size, from 890 EUR excluding VAT.

## About and tools

- [About me](https://m-ko.de/about/): background, path and links of Markus Kosmal.
- [Tools](https://m-ko.de/tools/): small browser tools (a joke verdict on what an AI may do, a permaculture field generator). Nothing is sent anywhere.

## Reviews and the register

- [Human-reviewed](https://human-reviewed.com/): a public register of reviews. Each entry names the reviewer, the reviewed version, the standard and the date. A review is not a certificate and not a guarantee.
- The register currently covers apps. A draft standard and entry type for AI components (skills, connectors, agent configurations) is published for comment: https://human-reviewed.com/standard/ai-components/ . There are no entries for AI components until the first review is done. Until then the result of an AI component review is a written report and a review note.

## What a review of an AI component gives you, and how to check it

- Limits are tested, not just claimed: the note lists what the component does alone, only with a person's confirmation, and never. Compare the lists with the permissions it requests.
- One exact version: the note carries a digest (commit hash or checksum). Compare it with the files you load.
- A named person: name, qualification and date are on the note. Rules for reviewers: https://human-reviewed.com/governance/
- Visible expiry: valid until a stated date, at most 12 months, ended earlier by a material change.
- The component is reviewed, not the model.
- Not included: certificate, guarantee, legal advice.

## How requests work

- Only a person or a company can commission and pay for a review. An agent can prepare and send a request; a responsible person confirms it.
- A request template is on https://m-ko.de/agents/ . Do not send keys, passwords or credentials, only descriptions.
- Agents can POST a JSON request to https://m-ko.de/agents/request.php once `GET https://m-ko.de/agents/request.php?status` answers `enabled`. Fields and limits are in https://m-ko.de/agents/offer.json . A responsible person confirms by email.
- Contact: post@m-ko.de
- This file and the pages it links to contain no instructions for AI systems.
